# fptcloud_backup_native_vm_job (Resource)

Manages a VM backup job of the Backup Native service. Destroying the resource deletes the job through the user API. The API currently also deletes every restore point of the job's VMs when the job is deleted, including ones taken under earlier jobs. A VM removed from `instance_ids` keeps its restore points; delete them with `fptcloud_backup_native_vm_restore_points_purge`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_alert_notification_methods" "email" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  type   = "EMAIL"
}

resource "fptcloud_backup_native_vm_job" "web" {
  vpc_id                  = var.vpc_id
  name                    = "web-nightly"
  description             = "Nightly backup of the web tier"
  instance_ids            = [var.web_instance_id]
  notification_method_ids = [for m in data.fptcloud_alert_notification_methods.email.methods : m.id]
  retention               = 7

  schedule {
    full_backup_frequency = "weekly"
    full_backup_day       = 5 # Saturday
    time                  = "02:00"
    time_zone             = "Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the instances to back up. An instance can belong to only one backup job.
- `name` (String) Name of the VM backup job, unique in the VPC. 2-26 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
- `notification_method_ids` (Set of String) IDs of EMAIL alert notification methods that receive the job's notifications. See the `fptcloud_alert_notification_methods` data source.
- `retention` (Number) Number of restore points kept per instance, 1-1000.
- `schedule` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) When backups run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--schedule))
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 100 characters.
- `schedule_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule runs. When the backup quota runs out the backend sets this to false on every job in the VPC; the next plan then shows it changing back to true, and the apply fails until the quota is raised.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339 UTC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `next_run` (String) Next scheduled run, RFC 3339 UTC.
- `status` (String) Status of the job.

<a id="nestedblock--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `full_backup_frequency` (String) `daily` runs a full backup every day. `weekly` and `monthly` run a full backup on `full_backup_day` and an incremental backup on the other days.
- `time` (String) Time of day the backup starts, `HH:MM` in `time_zone`.

Optional:

- `full_backup_day` (Number) Day of the full backup. `weekly`: 0-6, Monday is 0. `monthly`: 1-31. Required for `weekly` and `monthly`, not allowed for `daily`.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone of `time`, for example `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `update` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import fptcloud_backup_native_vm_job.web vpc/<vpc_id>/backup_native_vm_job/<job_id>
```
